title: Bipartite Coloring
statement:
Color an undirected graph using colors 1 and 2 so every edge has unequal endpoint colors. In every component, assign its smallest vertex color 1.

Input
n m followed by m undirected edges.

Output
Print IMPOSSIBLE if no coloring exists. Otherwise print the colors of nodes 1 through n.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed.
